en: The best thing happened in all my life Is that I found my Lord Jesus my King
The best choice I’ve made in all my life
Is that I’ve decided to serve Jesus my Lord

ko: 이 세상 살 동안 내가 걷는 길이
en: Though I stumble and fall in the valleys of life
Broken and weak, hurt and alone
Mighty hand of God, I know, holds me up
Never will I cease to serve my Jesus, my Lord

ko: 나는 주를 섬기는 것에 후회가 없습니다
내가 걸어온 모든 시간 다 주의 은혜니
en: No regrets, and no turning back, But there’s only one desire that’s to serve my Lord because He’s been faithful all along

ko: 내가 걸어갈 모든 날도 주만 섬기며 살리
en: Lord, please let me walk with You all the days of my lifeRejoicing, praising Jesus’ Name, till I see You face to face
This is my story, this is my song Praising my Savior all the day long This is my story, this is my song Praising my Savior all the day long
